# coval_test_set (Data Source)

Retrieves a Coval test set by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coval_test_set" "support" {
  id = "abc12345"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Test-set ID.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) RFC 3339 creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Test-set description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable test-set name.
- `name` (String) Canonical API resource name.
- `parameters` (Dynamic) JSON object mapping parameter names to value arrays.
- `slug` (String) URL-friendly test-set identifier.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags associated with the test set.
- `test_case_count` (Number) Number of active test cases.
- `test_set_metadata` (Dynamic) Arbitrary JSON object containing additional test-set configuration.
- `test_set_type` (String) Test-set type.
- `update_time` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the latest update.
